The best camera features on an iPhone Pro may depend on whether you opt for the largest model. So far, most reports have suggested the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will be identical in the camera department, but a leaker today is casting some doubt on that claim.

Specifically, they say two new features expected on both Pro models "may" be exclusive to the Pro Max……

The iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max have identical camera specs, with all three rear cameras using 48-megapixel sensors. Apple says the telephoto lens offers up to 8x optical zoom, but that's actually achieved through a 24-megapixel crop, so it's more accurate to say it offers 4x optical zoom with the option to crop to 8x.

We've so far (mostly) expected the Pro models this year to maintain consistent camera specs, with both featuring a variable aperture main lens and a larger aperture telephoto lens for better low-light performance.

However, leaker Ice Universe says two new telephoto features may be exclusive to the iPhone 18 Pro Max.

If accurate, that means you'll have to buy the Pro Max if you want the longest telephoto focal length and the best low-light performance on the telephoto. However, their use of the word "may" suggests they're not entirely confident about this claim, possibly having seen conflicting evidence within the Apple supply chain.

There have also been reports that the variable aperture system on the main lens may be Pro Max exclusive, but those reports have been conflicting as well.

If you've always preferred the smaller of the two Pro models but would switch to the Pro Max for better camera features, would you? Let us know in the comments.
